title: Updates
description: Check for new Aegis releases on the configured channel. Read-only — apply by downloading the release and running install.sh on the host.
notWired.body: Update checker not attached. It isn't being initialized in this build — enable it on the host during Aegis startup.
updateAvailable.description: Released {{date}} — you're on {{version}}. Download below, then run sudo bash install.sh on the host.
howToUpdate.description: Aegis is updated manually from the host. The panel checks for new releases but never downloads or installs them.
howToUpdate.step1: Download the release archive for your platform from the release page
howToUpdate.step1End: — see the download link in the "Update available" banner above.
howToUpdate.step2: Copy it to the Aegis host and unpack it.
howToUpdate.step3: From the unpacked directory, run the installer as root:
howToUpdate.note: The installer swaps the binary and restarts the service. Automatic in-panel updates were removed because they executed an unverified, network-fetched binary as the service user.
config.title: Configuration
config.description: In-memory only — persisted via the update repository, channel, and poll-interval settings in the service configuration.
config.pollHint: 0 = check only when "Check now" is pressed
channelDesc.stable: Stable releases only — recommended for production.
channelDesc.beta: Stable + beta + rc tags — pre-production validation.
channelDesc.nightly: All releases including nightly builds — bleeding edge.
releaseHistory.description: Every release the checker has cached. Cleared on daemon restart.
releaseHistory.empty: No releases cached yet. Click "Check now" above.
